blocks.text: Savol tuzish: yordamchi fe'l egadan oldin

O'zbekchada so'roq gapda so'z tartibi o'zgarmaydi — faqat **-mi** yoki so'roq so'zi qo'shiladi: Sen ishlaysan → Sen ishlaysan**mi**? Ingliz tilida esa **yordamchi fe'l egadan oldinga chiqadi** (inversiya): You are working → **Are** you working? Agar gapda yordamchi fe'l bo'lmasa (Present Simple va Past Simple), uni **do / does / did** bilan «yaratamiz». Asoslar qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 44–47-darslar), bu darsda — ega haqidagi savol, predlog bilan tugaydigan savollar va inkor savollarning nozik tomonlari.
Ega haqida savol: Who phoned? — do / did yo'q

**Who**, **What**, **Which**, **Whose**, **How many** gapning **egasi** haqida so'rasa, so'z tartibi darak gapdagidek qoladi va **do / does / did ishlatilmaydi**: Who **phoned** you? (Kim qo'ng'iroq qildi?), What **happened**? (Nima bo'ldi?). Agar savol **to'ldiruvchi** haqida bo'lsa — oddiy so'roq tartibi: Who **did** you **phone**? (Kimga qo'ng'iroq qilding?). O'zbekchada farqni kelishik ko'rsatadi (kim — kimni / kimga), inglizchada esa **do / did** borligi yoki yo'qligi ko'rsatadi.

rows: Which team **did** they **beat**? — Qaysi jamoani yutishdi?
How many people **came**? — Necha kishi keldi?
How many people **did** you **invite**? — Necha kishini taklif qilding?

items.text: Who **lives** in that big house on the corner?
What **happened** to your hand? It's all red.

blocks.text: Ingliz tilida fe'l bilan bog'liq predlog odatda savolning **oxirida** qoladi: Who are you **waiting for**? Where are you **from**? What are you **talking about**? O'zbekchada esa «kimni», «kim bilan», «nima haqida» bir joyda keladi, shuning uchun predlogni tushirib qoldirish oson. «What ... like?» — alohida ibora: «qanaqa?» (What's the weather **like**? What's your new boss **like**?). Predlogni oldinga chiqarish (With whom ...? About what ...?) — juda rasmiy, so'zlashuvda deyarli ishlatilmaydi.

items.text: What **are** you **looking at**? Is there something behind me?

blocks.text: Inkor savollar: Didn't you ...? Isn't it ...?

Inkor savol (**Isn't** it ...? **Didn't** you ...? **Haven't** you ...?) oddiy ma'lumot so'rash uchun emas. U uch narsani bildiradi: 1) **hayrat** — Didn't you hear the alarm? (Nahotki eshitmading?); 2) **«ha» javobini kutish** — Isn't it a lovely day? (Ajoyib kun, to'g'rimi?); 3) **Why don't / Why didn't** bilan — taklif yoki tanbeh: **Why don't** we go by train? (Poyezdda bora qolaylik), **Why didn't** you tell me? (Nega menga aytmading?). O'zbekchada bunga «**-maysanmi?**», «**emasmi?**», «**-ku**» to'g'ri keladi.
Inkor savolga javob: Yes yoki No?

Bu — o'zbeklar uchun eng qiyin joy. O'zbekchada javob **savolga** qo'shiladi: «Bormadingmi?» — «**Ha**, bormadim». Ingliz tilida esa javob **faktga** qarab beriladi: fakt ijobiy bo'lsa — **Yes**, salbiy bo'lsa — **No**, savol qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar. Didn't you go? — **No**, I didn't (bormadim). / **Yes**, I did (bordim). Shuning uchun o'zbekcha «Ha, bormadim» inglizchada **No, I didn't** bo'ladi.

items.text: **Didn't** you **get** my email? — **No**, I didn't. When did you send it?
**Isn't** this your bag? — **Yes**, it is. Thanks!
**Why don't** you **ask** your boss for a pay rise?

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Where you live?» → Where **do** you live? (o'zbekchada yordamchi fe'l yo'q); «What time the film starts?» → What time **does** the film start?; «Who did phone you?» → Who **phoned** you? (ega haqida savolda did yo'q); «Who you are waiting?» → Who **are you** waiting **for**?; «How it is called?» → What **is** it **called**?; «Didn't you see him? — Yes, I didn't» → **No**, I didn't.

Ega haqidagi savolni tekshirish: javobni darak gap qilib ko'ring. «Who phoned? — **Tom** phoned.» — so'roq so'zi o'rniga ega keldi, demak, do kerak emas. Inkor savolga javob berishda esa savolni unuting va faqat faktga qarang: bordingizmi — **Yes**, bormadingizmi — **No**.

rows: Present / Past Simple — do / does / did
Who are you **talking to**? What's it **like**?
Javob faktga qarab: Yes = ha (ijobiy), No = yo'q (salbiy)

examples.title: Word order: **Are you** ...? **Has she** ...? **Can you** ...?
examples.description: be, have va modal fe'llar bilan savol: yordamchi fe'l egadan oldinga chiqadi, do kerak emas.

sentences.text: **Are** you **coming** to Aziz's birthday party on Saturday, or are you working?
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni Azizning tug'ilgan kuniga **kelyapsanmi** yoki ishlayapsanmi?

sentences.text: **Has** Madina **finished** her thesis yet, or is she still writing it?
sentences.translation: Madina dissertatsiyasini **tugatdimi** yoki hali yozyaptimi?

sentences.text: **Can** you **recommend** a good hotel near the old city in Bukhara?
sentences.translation: Buxoroning eski shahri yaqinida yaxshi mehmonxona **tavsiya qila olasizmi**?

sentences.text: Where **were** you **going** when I saw you at the station yesterday?
sentences.translation: Kecha sizni vokzalda ko'rganimda qayerga **ketayotgan edingiz**?

sentences.text: How long **have** you **been learning** English? Your accent is very good.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilini qancha vaqtdan beri **o'rganyapsiz**? Talaffuzingiz juda yaxshi.

sentences.text: **Will** the new metro station **be** open before the end of the year?
sentences.translation: Yangi metro bekati yil oxirigacha **ochiladimi**?

sentences.text: What **should** I **wear** to the interview — a suit or something more casual?
sentences.translation: Suhbatga nima **kiyib borishim kerak** — kostyummi yoki oddiyroq narsami?

sentences.text: Why **is** everybody **looking** at me? Have I got something on my face?
sentences.translation: Nega hamma menga **qarayapti**? Yuzimda biror narsa bormi?

sentences.text: **Had** you **met** Kate before you started working together?
sentences.translation: Birga ishlashni boshlashdan oldin Keyt bilan **tanish edingizmi**?

sentences.text: Which train **would** you **take** if you wanted to get to Oxford quickly?
sentences.translation: Oksfordga tez yetib bormoqchi bo'lsangiz, qaysi poyezdga **chiqardingiz**?

examples.title: **Do** / **does** / **did**: questions in simple tenses
examples.description: Present Simple va Past Simple da yordamchi fe'l yo'q, shuning uchun savolda do / does / did qo'shiladi, asosiy fe'l esa asosiy shaklda qoladi.

sentences.text: **Do** you **know** anyone who can fix a washing machine?
sentences.translation: Kir yuvish mashinasini tuzata oladigan birortasini **bilasizmi**?

sentences.text: What time **does** the last bus to Chilanzar **leave**?
sentences.translation: Chilonzorga oxirgi avtobus soat nechada **jo'naydi**?

sentences.text: Where **did** you **buy** that jacket? I've been looking for one like it.
sentences.translation: O'sha kurtkani qayerdan **sotib olgansiz**? Men ham shunaqasini qidiryapman.

sentences.text: How **did** Oliver and Sarah **meet**? — At university, in a chemistry class.
sentences.translation: Oliver bilan Sara qanday **tanishgan**? — Universitetda, kimyo darsida.

sentences.text: **Does** this price **include** breakfast, or do we pay extra?
sentences.translation: Bu narx nonushtani ham **o'z ichiga oladimi** yoki alohida to'laymizmi?

sentences.text: Why **did** Jasur **leave** the party so early last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha Jasur ziyofatdan nega bunchalik erta **ketib qoldi**?

sentences.text: How often **do** you **visit** your grandparents in Samarkand?
sentences.translation: Samarqanddagi bobo-buvingiznikiga qanchalik tez-tez **borasiz**?

sentences.text: **Did** the medicine **help**, or do you still have a headache?
sentences.translation: Dori **yordam berdimi** yoki hali ham boshingiz og'riyaptimi?

sentences.text: Which university **did** your brother **choose** in the end?
sentences.translation: Oxir-oqibat akangiz qaysi universitetni **tanladi**?

sentences.text: What **does** the word «deadline» **mean**? I keep hearing it at work.
sentences.translation: «Deadline» so'zi nimani **anglatadi**? Ishda tez-tez eshitaman.

examples.title: Subject questions: **Who phoned**? **What happened**?
examples.description: Who, What, Which, Whose, How many — gapning egasi haqida so'raganda do / did yo'q, tartib darak gapdagidek.

sentences.text: Who **phoned** you at midnight? It woke up the whole family.
sentences.translation: Yarim tunda sizga kim **qo'ng'iroq qildi**? Butun oilani uyg'otib yubordi.

sentences.text: What **happened** at the meeting? Everyone looks so upset.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishda nima **bo'ldi**? Hamma juda xafa ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: Who **won** the match last night? I fell asleep at half-time.
sentences.translation: Kecha o'yinda kim **yutdi**? Men tanaffusda uxlab qolibman.

sentences.text: Which bus **goes** to the airport from here?
sentences.translation: Bu yerdan aeroportga qaysi avtobus **boradi**?

sentences.text: How many people **came** to the conference in the end?
sentences.translation: Oxir-oqibat konferensiyaga qancha odam **keldi**?

sentences.text: What **made** you change your mind about the job in London?
sentences.translation: Londondagi ish haqidagi fikringizni nima **o'zgartirdi**?

sentences.text: Whose car **is blocking** the entrance? I can't get out.
sentences.translation: Kirish joyini kimning mashinasi **to'sib turibdi**? Chiqa olmayapman.

sentences.text: Who **teaches** you English — a local teacher or a native speaker?
sentences.translation: Sizga ingliz tilidan kim **dars beradi** — mahalliy o'qituvchimi yoki ingliz?

sentences.text: What **caused** the delay? We've been waiting for over an hour.
sentences.translation: Kechikishga nima **sabab bo'ldi**? Bir soatdan ortiq kutyapmiz.

sentences.text: Which of your friends **lives** closest to the city centre?
sentences.translation: Do'stlaringizdan qaysi biri shahar markaziga **eng yaqin yashaydi**?

examples.title: Subject or object? **Who invited** / **Who did** ... **invite**
examples.description: Juftliklar: ega haqida savol (do yo'q) va to'ldiruvchi haqida savol (do / did bor). O'zbekchada farqni kelishik ko'rsatadi: kim — kimni / kimga.

sentences.text: Who **invited** Emma to the party? — Tom did.
sentences.translation: Emmani ziyofatga kim **taklif qildi**? — Tom.

sentences.text: Who **did** Emma **invite** to the party? — Only her closest friends.
sentences.translation: Emma ziyofatga kimni **taklif qildi**? — Faqat eng yaqin do'stlarini.

sentences.text: What **broke** the window — a ball or a stone?
sentences.translation: Derazani nima **sindirdi** — to'pmi yoki toshmi?

sentences.text: What **did** the children **break** this time? — The neighbour's window, I'm afraid.
sentences.translation: Bolalar bu safar nimani **sindirishdi**? — Afsuski, qo'shnining derazasini.

sentences.text: Who **told** you about the new job? — My cousin, he works there.
sentences.translation: Yangi ish haqida sizga kim **aytdi**? — Amakivachcham, u o'sha yerda ishlaydi.

sentences.text: And who **did** you **tell** about it? — Nobody except my wife.
sentences.translation: Siz bu haqda kimga **aytdingiz**? — Xotinimdan boshqa hech kimga.

sentences.text: Which team **beat** Pakhtakor on Sunday? — A team from Fergana.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni «Paxtakor»ni qaysi jamoa **yutdi**? — Farg'onalik jamoa.

sentences.text: Which team **did** Pakhtakor **beat** in the cup final?
sentences.translation: Kubok finalida «Paxtakor» qaysi jamoani **yutdi**?

sentences.text: How many students **passed** the exam? — Almost all of them.
sentences.translation: Imtihondan nechta talaba **o'tdi**? — Deyarli hammasi.

sentences.text: How many questions **did** you **answer** correctly?
sentences.translation: Nechta savolga to'g'ri **javob berdingiz**?

examples.title: Prepositions at the end: **Who** ... **for**? **What** ... **like**?
examples.description: Fe'l bilan bog'liq predlog savol oxirida qoladi: waiting for, talking about, from, with, belong to. What ... like? — «qanaqa?».

sentences.text: Who **are** you **waiting for** outside the bank? — My brother; he's late as usual.
sentences.translation: Bank oldida kimni **kutyapsiz**? — Akamni, u odatdagidek kechikyapti.

sentences.text: Where **is** your new colleague **from**? — From Edinburgh, I think.
sentences.translation: Yangi hamkasbingiz **qayerlik**? — Menimcha, edinburglik.

sentences.text: What **are** you **talking about**? I didn't take your charger.
sentences.translation: Nima **haqida gapiryapsan**? Men sening zaryadlovchingni olmadim.

sentences.text: Tell me, what **was** the weather **like** in Khiva? — Hot and dry, as usual.
sentences.translation: Ayt-chi, Xivada ob-havo **qanaqa edi**? — Odatdagidek issiq va quruq.

sentences.text: Who **did** you **go** to the cinema **with**? — With some friends from work.
sentences.translation: Kinoga kim **bilan bordingiz**? — Ishxonadagi do'stlar bilan.

sentences.text: And your new boss — what's he **like**? — Strict, but very fair.
sentences.translation: Yangi boshlig'ingiz-chi — **qanaqa odam**? — Qattiqqo'l, lekin juda adolatli.

sentences.text: Which hotel **did** you **stay at** in Manchester?
sentences.translation: Manchesterda qaysi mehmonxonada **qoldingiz**?

sentences.text: What **is** this tool **used for**? I've never seen one before.
sentences.translation: Bu asbob nima **uchun ishlatiladi**? Ilgari hech ko'rmagan edim.

sentences.text: Who **does** this laptop **belong to**? It's been here since Monday.
sentences.translation: Bu noutbuk **kimniki**? Dushanbadan beri shu yerda turibdi.

sentences.text: So what **are** you **worried about**? The exam isn't until next month.
sentences.translation: Unda nimadan **xavotirdasiz**? Imtihon kelasi oyda-ku.

examples.title: Negative questions: **Didn't you** ...? **Isn't it** ...?
examples.description: Inkor savol — hayrat yoki «ha» javobini kutish. O'zbekchada «-madingmi?», «emasmi?», «-ku».

sentences.text: **Didn't** you **hear** the alarm? It rang for ten minutes!
sentences.translation: Signalni **eshitmadingmi**? O'n daqiqa jiringladi-ku!

sentences.text: **Isn't** it a beautiful view? I could look at these mountains all day.
sentences.translation: Manzara ajoyib **emasmi**? Bu tog'larga kun bo'yi qarab o'tirsam ham zerikmayman.

sentences.text: **Haven't** you **finished** that report yet? The deadline was yesterday.
sentences.translation: Hali o'sha hisobotni **tugatmadingmi**? Muddat kecha edi-ku.

sentences.text: **Don't** you **remember** me? We were at school together in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Meni **eslamaysizmi**? Farg'onada birga maktabda o'qiganmiz-ku.

sentences.text: **Wasn't** Bekzod **supposed** to be here at ten?
sentences.translation: Bekzod soat o'nda shu yerda bo'lishi kerak **emasmidi**?

sentences.text: **Can't** you **sleep**? It's three o'clock in the morning.
sentences.translation: **Uxlay olmayapsanmi**? Tungi soat uch bo'ldi.

sentences.text: **Aren't** you **cold** in that thin jacket? It's minus five outside.
sentences.translation: O'sha yupqa kurtkada **sovqotmayapsanmi**? Tashqarida minus besh.

sentences.text: **Doesn't** Madina **work** at the hospital? Ask her about the test results.
sentences.translation: Madina shifoxonada **ishlamaydimi**? Undan tahlil natijalari haqida so'rang.

sentences.text: **Won't** you **stay** for dinner? My mother has cooked plov.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatga **qolmaysizmi**? Onam palov damlagan.

sentences.text: **Weren't** you **living** in London when the Olympics were held there?
sentences.translation: Olimpiada o'tkazilgan paytda Londonda **yashamasmidingiz**?

examples.title: **Why don't** we ...? and answers: **No**, I didn't
examples.description: Why don't / Why didn't — taklif va tanbeh. Inkor savolga javob faktga qarab: o'zbekcha «Ha, bormadim» — inglizcha «No, I didn't».

sentences.text: **Why don't** we take a taxi? It's getting late.
sentences.translation: Taksiga **o'tira qolaylik** — kech bo'lyapti.

sentences.text: **Why didn't** you tell me you were ill? I would have helped.
sentences.translation: Kasal ekaningni nega menga **aytmading**? Yordam bergan bo'lardim.

sentences.text: **Wouldn't** it be cheaper to take the train instead of flying?
sentences.translation: Samolyot o'rniga poyezdda borish arzonroq **bo'lmaydimi**?

sentences.text: **Didn't** you **lock** the door? — **No**, I forgot, sorry!
sentences.translation: Eshikni **qulflamadingmi**? — **Ha**, esimdan chiqibdi, kechir!

sentences.text: **Isn't** Aziz coming with us? — **Yes**, he is. He's just parking the car.
sentences.translation: Aziz biz bilan **bormaydimi**? — **Yo'q**, boradi. Mashinani qo'yyapti, xolos.

sentences.text: **Haven't** you **seen** this film? — **No**, never. Is it any good?
sentences.translation: Bu filmni **ko'rmaganmisan**? — **Ha**, hech ko'rmaganman. Yaxshimi?

sentences.text: **Don't** you **like** spicy food? — **Yes**, I do, but not this spicy!
sentences.translation: Achchiq taomni **yoqtirmaysanmi**? — **Yo'q**, yoqtiraman, lekin bunchalik achchig'ini emas!

sentences.text: **Why not** ask your teacher? She'll know the answer.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchingdan **so'rasang-chi**? U javobni biladi.

sentences.text: **Shouldn't** you be at work by now? It's already half past nine.
sentences.translation: Hozir ishda **bo'lishing kerak emasmi**? Soat to'qqiz yarim bo'ldi-ku.

sentences.text: **Didn't** Kate **pass** her driving test? — **Yes**, she did, on her third attempt!
sentences.translation: Keyt haydovchilik imtihonidan **o'tmadimi**? — **Yo'q**, o'tdi, uchinchi urinishda!

examples.title: Dialogue: back from a trip to London
examples.description: Ikki do'st suhbati: oddiy savollar, ega haqida savol, predlog oxirida, inkor savollar va ularga javob.

sentences.text: — Welcome back! When **did** you **get** home from London?
sentences.translation: — Xush kelibsan! Londondan qachon **qaytding**?

sentences.text: — Late last night. **Didn't** you **get** my message from the airport?
sentences.translation: — Kecha kechasi. Aeroportdan yozgan xabarimni **olmadingmi**?

sentences.text: — No, my phone was dead. So what **was** the city **like**?
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, telefonimning quvvati tugagan edi. Xo'sh, shahar **qanaqa ekan**?

sentences.text: — Fantastic, but so expensive! What **happened** here while I was away?
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib, lekin juda qimmat! Men yo'qligimda bu yerda nima **bo'ldi**?

sentences.text: — Not much. By the way, who **did** you **stay with** — your cousin?
sentences.translation: — Hech narsa. Aytgancha, kimnikida **qolding** — amakivachchangnikidami?

sentences.text: — Yes, in his flat near Hyde Park. **Haven't** you **met** him?
sentences.translation: — Ha, uning Hayd-park yaqinidagi kvartirasida. U bilan **tanishmaganmisan**?

sentences.text: — **No**, never. What **does** he **do** there?
sentences.translation: — **Ha**, hech tanishmaganman. U yerda nima **ish qiladi**?

sentences.text: — He's a doctor. **Isn't** your sister studying medicine too?
sentences.translation: — U shifokor. Singling ham tibbiyotda **o'qimaydimi**?

sentences.text: — **Yes**, she is, in Tashkent. **Why don't** you **come** for dinner and tell us everything?
sentences.translation: — **Ha**, o'qiydi, Toshkentda. Kechki ovqatga kelib, hammasini **aytib bermaysanmi**?

sentences.text: — Great idea! Which day **suits** you best — Friday or Saturday?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r fikr! Senga qaysi kun **qulay** — jumami yoki shanbami?
